_comment_azuread: The CHO API app registration. The portal requests api://<ClientId>/Cho.Token for the signed-in user and forwards that token here.

TokenService._comment_platform: CHO's own Entra directory id. Override: TokenService__PlatformTenantId. Empty disables platform administration.

_comment_signing: Production signs inside Key Vault: TokenSigning__KeyVaultKeyId=https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/keys/cho-token-signing. See docs/security/portal-token-service.md.
_comment_choauth: Service token for calls to tenant-service. Override: ChoAuth__ServiceToken__PrivateKeyPem (from Key Vault).
